# Northwind Retail Quarterly Report Q3 2026

## SECTION-ALPHA-7731 Channel Mix

Online revenue grew 18 percent quarter over quarter and now accounts for 41 percent
of total revenue. Retail stores declined 4 percent. The marketplace channel grew
from 3 percent to 7 percent of total revenue and carries the lowest margin.

## SECTION-BRAVO-4402 Working Capital

Inventory value rose to 12.4 million while weekly sales velocity stayed flat at
23 thousand units. Four SKUs account for 61 percent of the excess stock. The
procurement cycle was shortened from 21 days to 14 days starting in October.

## SECTION-CHARLIE-9015 Recommendation

Management should protect the online growth rate, clear the four overstock SKUs
before the holiday window, and keep discounting below 9 percent of list price.
